name: Slaying the Beast
summary: In Orgrimmar’s Cleft of Shadow, Neeru Fireblade sends Horde adventurers into Ragefire Chasm to hunt Taragaman the Hungerer. He claims Warchief Thrall ordered the hunt and demands the towering felguard’s heart as proof the demonic cult has fallen.

sections.title: A Threat Beneath the City
sections.body: Ragefire Chasm lies beneath Orgrimmar’s red earthen streets, a fiery fissure filled with troggs, beasts, and covert Searing Blade agents. In the Cleft of Shadow above, Neeru Fireblade presents himself as a loyal servant carrying out Thrall’s order to cleanse this demonic rot. He points to Taragaman the Hungerer, a massive felguard in the cavern’s heart, and names him as the mastermind behind the cult below the city.

sections.title: The Warlock's Deception
sections.body: Returning Taragaman’s heart to Neeru Fireblade brings high praise and promises that Thrall will be appeased. Taragaman is only an expendable brute, not the cult’s true leader. By sending Horde heroes after the demon, Neeru gives Thrall a visible victory to quiet suspicion while shielding the Searing Blade’s real leadership and deeper operations beneath Orgrimmar from closer scrutiny.

faq.answer: Taragaman the Hungerer is a powerful felguard on a rocky platform in the heart of Ragefire Chasm. Neeru Fireblade names him as the leader of the Searing Blade cultists beneath Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Slaying the Beast?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade gives the assignment from his tent in the Cleft of Shadow, Orgrimmar’s cavernous warlock quarter.

faq.q: Why does Neeru want Taragaman's heart?
aliases: why does neeru want the heart
faq.answer: Neeru says Taragaman’s heart will prove to Warchief Thrall that the demonic threat beneath Orgrimmar has been destroyed.

faq.q: Is Taragaman actually the leader of the Searing Blade?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade names Taragaman as their leader. Taragaman is a formidable felguard among the Searing Blade cultists in Ragefire Chasm’s heart.
Taragaman the Hungerer is on a rock platform surrounded by lava in Ragefire Chasm’s middle reaches, among Searing Blade cultists.

faq.q: How does this quest connect to Hidden Enemies?
faq.answer: In the Hidden Enemies storyline, Thrall investigates the Shadow Council’s infiltration of Orgrimmar and watches Neeru Fireblade closely. Neeru offers this hunt to show Thrall visible results against the Searing Blade.

angles.text: As a warlock working from the Cleft of Shadow alongside Neeru, you see the political tightrope of practicing fel magic under Thrall’s watchful gaze.
As a member of the Horde, you face an immediate threat to Orgrimmar’s safety when a demonic presence festers beneath the capital.
As an orc striving to escape the legacy of the demon blood curse, you can find the presence of a felguard and demon cult beneath Thrall’s throne an intolerable disgrace.
